$comment: Typechecks test files, which the per-package configs deliberately exclude.
Those configs exclude tests because tests must not land in the published dist output. But the
consequence was that no test file in this repo was ever typechecked: vitest transpiles through
esbuild, which strips types without checking them. A test could assert against a property that
does not exist and still pass.
This config checks them without emitting. It resolves workspace packages to source rather than
dist so it does not depend on build order.
Run via `pnpm typecheck:tests`, included in `pnpm verify` and CI.
